text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited on the north side of Milepost Place, between Thorncliffe Park Drive and a point 15 metres west, and on the south side, between Thorncliffe Park Drive and a point 20 metres west. Currently parking is prohibited at all times on these segments of Milepost Place. The proposed stopping prohibition will address stopped vehicles unloading on these segments, which obstructs traffic at the intersection.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Milepost Place, between Thorncliffe Park Drive and a point 15 metres west. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Milepost Place, between Thorncliffe Park Drive and a point 20 metres west.
